title: Implementer guide: VTCCallPolicy enforcement
description: Section on implementing call-level media policies. Server-side enforcement of muteOnEntry, participantsCanUnmute, participantsCanShareScreen, participantsCanStartVideo. Media layer coordination (JMAP server sets the state, media layer must honor it). Ask-to-unmute UX flow. JSON examples of policy-gated VTCParticipant/set rejections.
